faqs.question: Why do you build websites with Next.js instead of WordPress?
faqs.answer: WordPress relies on bloated database queries, heavy PHP runtimes, and dozens of third-party plugins that degrade page speed and create critical security vulnerabilities. Next.js produces pre-rendered static HTML and edge-cached JavaScript, providing sub-second load times, superior Google Core Web Vitals, impervious security, and significantly higher conversion rates.

faqs.question: How long does a custom Next.js website development project take?
faqs.answer: A standard high-performance corporate or service website typically takes between 2 to 4 weeks from UX wireframing to production deployment. Complex web applications with bespoke backend workflows or multi-location programmatic routing take 4 to 6 weeks.

faqs.question: Do I own 100% of the website source code and assets?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. Upon final project sign-off and payment, you receive complete, unrestricted ownership of all Git repositories, source code, design assets, and production build scripts. There are zero proprietary lock-ins.

faqs.question: Will my website be fully mobile responsive and touch-optimized?
faqs.answer: Every layout is built mobile-first. We rigorously audit and optimize touch targets, typography scaling, fluid spacing, and navigation gestures across all major screen sizes from 320px smartphones up to 4K ultra-wide monitors.

faqs.question: How does Next.js website development help our Google search rankings?
faqs.answer: Google rewards websites that deliver instant page loads and zero layout shifts (Core Web Vitals). Furthermore, Next.js Server-Side Rendering guarantees that search engine bots receive fully rendered, rich HTML containing semantic tags and structured JSON-LD schema on the very first crawl pass.

faqs.question: Can I edit the text and images on my website without knowing how to code?
faqs.answer: Yes. We configure structured JSON data files or connect modern Headless CMS solutions (such as Sanity, Strapi, or Decoupled Markdown) allowing your non-technical team members to edit text, testimonials, pricing, and case studies effortlessly.

faqs.question: What happens after the website goes live? Do you provide maintenance?
faqs.answer: All projects include 30 days of complimentary post-launch monitoring, warranty support, and performance tuning. We also offer proactive monthly retainer packages covering security updates, edge CDN management, content additions, and CRO optimizations.

faqs.question: Can you migrate our existing WordPress or PHP website to Next.js without losing SEO rankings?
faqs.answer: Yes. We perform a complete URL inventory and implement strict 1-to-1 301 redirects, preserving all accumulated organic backlinks and search equity while massively elevating your Core Web Vitals.

faqs.question: How soon can we expect noticeable improvements in our Google search rankings?
faqs.answer: Technical fixes and on-page optimizations often show initial crawl improvements within 2 to 4 weeks. Meaningful page-1 rankings and compounding organic traffic growth typically materialize between months 3 to 6 as domain authority and programmatic indexing expand.

faqs.question: What is Programmatic SEO and how does it rank 500+ cities?
faqs.answer: Programmatic SEO uses automated, structured data models to generate hundreds of localized landing pages (e.g., /location/mumbai, /location/bengaluru). Each page receives unique localized context, city landmarks, local FAQs, and schema markup, allowing your business to capture high-intent local queries across every city in India and globally without manual page creation.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee #1 ranking on Google?

However, we guarantee rigorous adherence to Google Search Essentials, transparent monthly progress, zero spam tactics, and a proven track record of placing over 85% of target commercial keywords on Page 1.

faqs.question: Which social platforms should my business focus on?
faqs.answer: For B2B companies, tech startups, and professional services, LinkedIn and X (Twitter) are primary drivers of enterprise authority. For B2C, e-commerce, real estate, and lifestyle brands, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook deliver the highest visual reach and engagement.

faqs.question: Do I have to provide the photos and videos or do you create them?

faqs.question: Can I approve posts before they are published?

faqs.question: What files do I receive when the branding project is complete?
faqs.answer: You receive a master ZIP archive containing vector source files (.AI, .EPS, .SVG), print-ready PDFs with bleed lines, web-optimized PNGs with transparent backgrounds, high-resolution JPEGs, and an invitation to the shared Figma design system library.

faqs.question: Do I have complete trademark rights to the logo?
faqs.answer: Yes. All intellectual property and copyright rights are transferred to your company upon final delivery, allowing you to legally trademark your logo in any jurisdiction.
